tree-materials.webp.title: 3D tree bark, leaves, and needles

credits.title: Cottonwood during autumn leaf coloration along Hinkey Summit Road just north of Paradise Valley, Nevada
credits.author: Famartin

tree-materials.webp.changes: Cropped and resized oak bark, then sampled color palettes from the original maple, cottonwood and spruce images. Used those colors to draw individual leaves and needles on branching sprays. Packed the four surfaces into a texture atlas for the 3D trees. The bark strip retains its source license.
